narrative: 体系、军队、酒店和工厂都偏爱这种图式。谁拥有空间，取决于这套网格。
一个人只是一个单元，直到他与其他单元不再匹配为止。这种“不匹配”（一张空桌子、一件红色大衣、一个迟到的士兵）无需特写镜头，就能自动成为主体。
当这个地点本身独特而不规则时，这就不是对的工具。除非角色本人正试图把秩序强加于一间凌乱的公寓，否则强行给它套上一种图案会是一种图形上的谎言。
图案也可以在时间中回归：同样的调度出现在不同的一天。那属于一种结构性的回响，
但在构图层面，它依然需要一种可辨认的空间韵律，让观众能够衡量出变化。
how: 找到一个重复出现的单元，并把摄影机放在能让这个单元平铺展开的位置：一面立面的正视图、用长焦镜头压缩的一排物件，或一张办公桌的俯拍。对齐画面，使这种重复变得可数。
把“断裂点”安排在一个具有分量的位置上（一张缺失的桌子、一种不同的颜色、行进队列中一个静止不动的人物）。提示词：Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story.
when: 用它表现机构和复制品：酒店、办公室、军队、数据中心、合唱团。如果没有任何东西可以打破它，就不要把它当成单纯的壁纸使用。
vs: 对称构图（Symmetry）是一种镜像，是重复的一种特殊形式。图案可以沿一条线或一片区域延伸，而不需要镜像对称。
鸟瞰（Bird's-Eye View）常常通过消除地平线来揭示图案。建筑纹理（Architexture）把材质和立面当作一种质感处理，直到人物变成一个细节。
图案则是那种质感之中可以被计数的网格。单点透视（One-Point Perspective）可以把这种重复引导进一条隧道之中。
examples_film: 《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）把制服、房门和糕点盒平铺展开，让一处瑕疵变得清晰可读；《黑客帝国》（The Matrix）把复制品用作一种哲学式的图案。
《僵尸肖恩》（Shaun of the Dead）让一次去商店的路程在一个已经改变的世界里前后呼应；《大白鲨》（Jaws）和《帝国反击战》（The Empire Strikes Back）也在声音层面教会了我们“复现”这一手法，它是视觉回响的近亲：一个不断回归的形象，直到它变成一种体系。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是繁复杂乱的美术设计。破绽是堆满了各种物件，却没有任何可数的单元。
修正方法：选定一个母题，让摄影机对齐使其平铺展开，并孤立出那唯一的不匹配之处。

faq.q: 电影中的重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）是什么？
faq.a: 形状、色彩、线条、位置或动作不断重复，直到画面读作一个体系。这种图案设定了观众的预期。图案中的一处断裂往往就是主体所在。这种形式上的呼应也可以在另一天重新出现。

faq.q: 重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）与对称构图（Symmetry）有何区别？
faq.a: 对称构图是沿一条轴线的镜像。图案则是在一排、一片网格，或时间中重复一个单元。一排酒店房门可以构成一种图案，而不需要左右对称；一间镜像的大堂也可以只靠两翼对称就构成对称构图。

faq.q: 什么时候该用重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）？
faq.a: 用它表现体系：军队、酒店、工厂、办公室、合唱团。当有人未能成为其中一个单元时，用它制造断裂。除非角色本人正试图强加秩序，否则在不规则的私人空间中不要使用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）的提示词？
faq.a: 指明重复的单元和例外之处。示例：Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story。如果可能，数清这些单元的数量。明确指出那个断裂点。

narrative: Systems, armies, hotels, and factories love this diagram. Who owns space is the grid.
A person is a unit until they fail to match. That failure (an empty desk, a red coat, a late soldier) becomes the subject without a closer lens.
It is the wrong tool when the location is unique and irregular. Forcing a pattern onto a messy apartment is a graphic lie unless the character is trying to impose one.
Pattern can also return in time: the same blocking on a different day. That is structural echo.
Compositionally it still needs a recognizable spatial rhyme so the audience can measure change.
how: Find a repeating unit and put the camera where the unit tiles: elevation of a facade, a long lens compressing a row, an overhead of desks. Align so the repeat is countable.

Place the break on a power position (a missing unit, a different color, a still figure in a marching line). Prompt: Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story.
when: Use it for institutions and copies: hotels, offices, armies, data centers, choruses. Do not use it as wallpaper if nothing can break.
vs: Symmetry is a mirror, which is one kind of repeat. Pattern can run in a line or a field without mirroring.
Bird's-Eye View often reveals pattern by removing horizon. Architexture treats material and facade as texture until the person is a detail.
Pattern is the countable grid inside that texture. One-Point Perspective can aim the repeat into a tunnel.
examples_film: The Grand Budapest Hotel tiles uniforms, doors, and pastry boxes so a scuff reads. The Matrix uses copies as a philosophical pattern.

Shaun of the Dead rhymes a trip to the shop across a changed world. Jaws and The Empire Strikes Back also teach recurrence in sound, a cousin of visual echo: a figure that returns until it is a system.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is busy production design. The tell is lots of stuff and no countable unit.
The fix is to pick one motif, align the camera to tile it, and isolate the one mismatch.

faq.q: What is repetition and pattern in film?
faq.a: Shapes, colors, lines, positions, or actions repeat until the frame reads as a system. The pattern sets expectation. A break in the pattern is often the subject. Formal rhyme can also return on another day.

Symmetry mirrors across an axis. Pattern repeats a unit in a row, a grid, or in time. A line of hotel doors can be a pattern without left matching right. A mirrored lobby can be symmetrical with only two wings.

faq.q: When should I use repetition and pattern?
faq.a: Use it for systems: armies, hotels, factories, offices, choruses. Use a break when someone fails to be a unit. Skip it in irregular private space unless the character is imposing order.

faq.q: How do I prompt repetition and pattern for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the repeating unit and the exception. Example: Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story. Count the units if you can. Specify the break.
